name: Ginga o Sukue
source:
There is a crisis that can destroy the entire galaxy - such message arrives from the alien who is the first to notice it. Main character goes to the outer space on a spaceship to find nine passwords and prevent the disaster.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一场危机可能会摧毁整个银河系——这样的信息来自第一个注意到它的外星人。主角乘坐宇宙飞船前往外太空寻找九个密码并阻止灾难。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
